jxp_a_nobles_agenda_compile_land_rolls = {
	max_days_active = 3650
	can_select = {
		jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes
		is_bankrupt = no
		OR = {
			has_estate_agenda_auto_completion = { estate = estate_nobles }
			NOT = { num_of_cities = 8 }
		}
	}
	selection_weight = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = { factor = 0.50 is_at_war = yes }
	}
	task_requirements = {
		if = { limit = { has_estate_agenda_auto_completion = { estate = estate_nobles } } has_estate_agenda_auto_completion = { estate = estate_nobles } }
		else = { num_of_cities = 8 }
	}
	task_completed_effect = {
		on_completed_agenda_effect = { estate = estate_nobles }
		add_estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_nobles loyalty = 10 }
		add_mil_power = 15
	}
	fail_if = { is_bankrupt = yes }
	failing_effect = {
		on_failed_agenda_effect = yes
		clr_auto_complete_flag = yes
		add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_nobles desc = EST_VAL_AGENDA_DENIED loyalty = -5 duration = 3650 }
	}
	invalid_trigger = { NOT = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes } }
	on_invalid = { clr_auto_complete_flag = yes }
}

	max_days_active = 3650
	can_select = {
		jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes
		is_bankrupt = no
		OR = {
			has_estate_agenda_auto_completion = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes }
			NOT = { num_of_cities = 12 }
		}
	}
	selection_weight = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = { factor = 0.50 is_at_war = yes }
	}
	task_requirements = {
		if = { limit = { has_estate_agenda_auto_completion = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes } } has_estate_agenda_auto_completion = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes } }
		else = { num_of_cities = 12 }
	}
	task_completed_effect = {
		on_completed_agenda_effect = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes }
		add_estate_loyalty = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes loyalty = 10 }
		add_adm_power = 15
	}
	fail_if = { is_bankrupt = yes }
	failing_effect = {
		on_failed_agenda_effect = yes
		clr_auto_complete_flag = yes
		add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes desc = EST_VAL_AGENDA_DENIED loyalty = -5 duration = 3650 }
	}
	invalid_trigger = { NOT = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes } }
	on_invalid = { clr_auto_complete_flag = yes }
}
